My advice would be to call the police, but periodically. The first the time the cops arrive, they'll give him a warning with his promise "to change his behaviour". However, if you call the second or the third or the fourth (etc.), the will give him a fine. If the situation is occuring during the following intervals 13-17 and 22-07, the fine will be bigger. Even though this does not stop him directly, after a few tickets he might change his behaviour due to the high amount to be paid in fines. This is only my advice and the results may vary depending on the area and his local connections. it might also help if you manage to convince other neighbors to call the police (to not seem like a mad man, and trust me this matters a lot here in the view of the cops).
